codeSnippet:
# "ana" -> "Ana"
name = raw.____()

explanation.en: capitalize() upper-cases the first character only.

codeSnippet:
# "HELLO" -> "hello"
q = text.____()

explanation.en: lower() converts every letter to lowercase.
rjust pads on the left until the string reaches the width.

codeSnippet:
# does the file end in .csv?
ok = path.____(".csv")

explanation.en: endswith() tests a suffix and returns a boolean.

codeSnippet:
# add a key only if it is missing
cfg.____("port", 8080)

explanation.en: setdefault inserts the value only when the key is absent.

codeSnippet:
# merge another dict into this one
base.____(extra)

explanation.en: update() copies the other mapping's pairs in.
reversed() iterates a sequence backwards without copying it.
raise throws the exception you construct.

codeSnippet:
// add an item to the FRONT
queue.____('first');

explanation.en: unshift() inserts at the start of an array.

codeSnippet:
// position of the LAST match
const i = list.____('a');

explanation.en: lastIndexOf() searches from the end backwards.

codeSnippet:
// index of the first match, or -1
const i = rows.____((r) => r.ok);

explanation.en: findIndex() returns the position, while find() returns the element.

codeSnippet:
// object -> [[key, value], ...]
const pairs = Object.____(user);

explanation.en: Object.entries() returns key/value pairs.

codeSnippet:
// [[k, v], ...] -> object
const obj = Object.____(pairs);

explanation.en: Object.fromEntries() is the inverse of entries().

codeSnippet:
// object -> array of its values
const vals = Object.____(scores);

explanation.en: Object.values() collects the values into an array.

codeSnippet:
// object -> JSON text
const body = JSON.____(payload);

explanation.en: JSON.stringify() serialises a value to text.
preventDefault() stops the browser's built-in action.
stopPropagation() keeps the event from bubbling up.
Array.isArray() is the reliable test — typeof reports 'object'.
instanceof walks the prototype chain to test the constructor.

codeSnippet:
// make the method keep its object
const bound = obj.run.____(obj);

explanation.en: bind() returns a copy whose `this` is fixed.

codeSnippet:
// keep only the truthy values
const clean = rows.filter(____);

explanation.en: Passing Boolean as the predicate drops every falsy entry.

codeSnippet:
// wait, then continue
await new Promise((r) => ____(r, 500));

explanation.en: setTimeout resolves the promise after the delay.

codeSnippet:
// read the id written in the markup
const id = el.____.userId;

explanation.en: dataset exposes every data-* attribute in camelCase.

codeSnippet:
// toggle a css class safely
el.____.toggle('active');

explanation.en: classList gives add/remove/toggle without touching the whole class string.

codeSnippet:
# every value that is in BOTH sets
both = a.____(b)

explanation.en: intersection() keeps the members present in both sets.

codeSnippet:
# values in a but NOT in b
only = a.____(b)

explanation.en: difference() removes anything also found in the other set.

codeSnippet:
# remove if present, ignore if not
tags.____("old")

explanation.en: discard() never raises, unlike remove() on a missing member.

codeSnippet:
# group values under a key, no KeyError
from collections import defaultdict
by = ____(list)

explanation.en: defaultdict(list) creates an empty list on first access to a key.

codeSnippet:
# pull the next item from an iterator
first = ____(it)

explanation.en: next() advances an iterator by one step.
int() truncates the fraction instead of rounding.

codeSnippet:
# reuse the file handle safely
____ open(path) as f:
    data = f.read()

explanation.en: A with block closes the file even if the body raises.
continue jumps straight to the next iteration.
super() reaches the parent class implementation.
__init__ runs when the instance is created.
extends sets up the prototype chain to the base class.
static puts the method on the class itself.
throw raises the error for the nearest catch.
The rest parameter gathers the extra arguments into an array.

codeSnippet:
// read a nested value without crashing
const city = user____.address?.city;

explanation.en: Optional chaining short-circuits to undefined instead of throwing.

codeSnippet:
// keep 0 but default null/undefined
const n = input ____ 10;

explanation.en: ?? only falls back on null or undefined, unlike ||.

codeSnippet:
// wait for all, keep failures too
const res = await Promise.____(tasks);

explanation.en: allSettled resolves with every outcome instead of rejecting on the first failure.

codeSnippet:
// a key that cannot collide
const hidden = ____('meta');

explanation.en: Every Symbol is unique, so it never clashes with another key.
yield hands one value to the caller and pauses the generator.

codeSnippet:
# a lightweight immutable record
from typing import NamedTuple
class P(____):
    x: int

explanation.en: Subclassing NamedTuple gives a small immutable class with named fields.
nonlocal targets the enclosing function's variable, not a global one.
@property lets the method be read like a plain attribute.
@dataclass writes __init__, __repr__ and __eq__ for you.

codeSnippet:
// a value that may be absent
let name: string | ____ = undefined;

explanation.en: The union must include undefined for the assignment to type-check.

codeSnippet:
// every field optional, none required
type Draft = ____<User>;

explanation.en: Partial<T> maps every property of T to optional.

codeSnippet:
// nothing may be reassigned
type Frozen = ____<Config>;

explanation.en: Readonly<T> marks every property of T as readonly.
